* '''Playtest''' ([[Kashyyyk: Forest Depths (Playtest)]]): Card image published 22 June 2021<ref name="img-Playtest">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyyk_forest_depths.png</code> ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/ee4c4cd8bccdd1870eb7593e38093132a51fe2c4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyyk_forest_depths.png holotable commit ee4c4cd], 22 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyykforestdepths.png</code> ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyykforestdepths.png holotable commit 30816d1], 22 June 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: While you control, Wookiees are destiny +1. Dark: No starships or vehicles here.” Playtest image: uploaded on 22 June 2021, the evening before the set's official release (23 June 2021), and replaced on release day. The card is stored upright (portrait: PNG 703×980; no GIF copy yet); the same day the files were renamed (holotable 30816d1, “filename fixes”, same image). Words as on the released card.
* '''Original''' (this page): Card image published 23 June 2021<ref name="img-Original">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/kashyykforestdepths.gif</code> ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/kashyykforestdepths.gif holotable commit 9319460], 23 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyykforestdepths.png</code> ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyykforestdepths.png holotable commit 9319460], 23 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyyykforestdepths.png</code> ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/8e51417b4d68f8ea5e01973d7bc59782d9f6f5f4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyyykforestdepths.png holotable commit 8e51417], 23 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/large/kashyyykforestdepths.gif</code> ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/8e51417b4d68f8ea5e01973d7bc59782d9f6f5f4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/kashyyykforestdepths.gif holotable commit 8e51417], 23 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/large/kashyyykforestdepths.gif</code> ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/40df861acee3c7f6d8f2414718ad5cd2ca74ad04/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/kashyyykforestdepths.gif holotable commit 40df861], 23 June 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: While you control, Wookiees are destiny +1. Dark: No starships or vehicles here.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 15 release (23 June 2021): the PC re-uploaded the card turned 90° to landscape, the way location cards are shown (holotable 9319460, “fixing rotation on v15”: PNG 980×703, GIF 745×534). Same image, words and layout as the playtest upload apart from the orientation. Every published image that differs from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026). Later the same day the file name was corrected from “kashyyk” to “kashyyyk” (holotable 8e51417, same image). Later the same day the PC re-made the GIF from the PNG (holotable 40df861, “Making MISSING gifs from hires pngs”); it differs only by GIF colour reduction (encoding noise), so it is the same publication, not a separate version.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kashyyyk: Forest Depths (Errata)]]): '''First published 20 April 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyyykforestdepths.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Card image published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/kashyyykforestdepths.gif</code> ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/kashyyykforestdepths.gif holotable commit 3f7288d], 21 April 2022); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyyykforestdepths.png</code> ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyyykforestdepths.png holotable commit 2640d50], 20 April 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: While you control, Wookiees are destiny +1. Dark: No starships or vehicles here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-rendered the card from a new high-resolution master (holotable 2640d50, “Set 18 and errata”, 20 April 2022: PNG now 1039×745; the GIF copy, holotable 3f7288d, 21 April 2022, stays 745×534), so art, frame, icons and text all render slightly differently. Most visibly: the line down the right border “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” became “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” in small capitals; the Kashyyyk site icons beside the titles are redrawn (red-brown → blue-grey) and the [Episode I] icon is redrawn. Words unchanged. This image was first published on 20 April 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/kashyyykforestdepths.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
